title: Route remote template cloning through the shared GitHub remote-base helper
description: Route remote template cloning through the shared GitHub remote-base helper
acceptance_criteria: clone_repo composes its git URL via github::remote_url rather than an inline https://github.com literal; templates init <owner>/<repo> clones and renders from a local bare repository with no network access; reverting the one-line remote.rs change makes that test fail by attempting a real clone; outside cfg(debug_assertions) the override is absent and the production constant is used; cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo fmt --check are green.
